results.title: Full backup containing saved OS state (pa_os_v2) exported from the UI is accepted and restored byte-identically
Older full backup without pa_os_v2 still restores and leaves no OS key behind
Heavy primer logged through the real Giant A UI produces a backup that validates and restores
Strength-method preference keys are still validated (unknown method rejected)
pa_strength_hist records still receive history-record validation (non-list rejected)
Cluster-split note with < and > logged through the real workout UI backs up and restores
Markup typed as a cluster-split note is shown as text and never rendered as HTML after reload/resume
Markup in other history text (exercise name) is still rejected
Cluster-split notes must be text without control characters
Pre-restore snapshot downloaded from the UI is itself a restorable backup that recovers the original data exactly
Two consecutive restores keep two recovery generations; the older one is downloadable from the UI
Restore that fails mid-write (real browser storage quota) leaves data AND existing snapshots unchanged, with a clear error
When no rollback snapshot can be stored, restore is refused before anything changes, with a clear error
When space allows only one generation, the older generation is dropped (not the newest) and restore proceeds
A snapshot left by HQ 2.3 (bare key map) is still downloadable as a restorable backup and is kept as the older generation
Backup containing a legacy draft without clusters validates and restores byte-identically
Legacy draft without clusters resumes in the real UI; Myo-Reps stages render and ADD MINI-SET works without errors
Sessions with malformed clusters are still rejected
OS text already in storage (including values the validator would reject) is escaped on Home and all 15 OS screens
Imported OS backup with markup in every text field restores, displays literally, and never executes
Full realistic dataset (all storage keys) round-trips byte-identically via UI export → import → restore; unrelated keys preserved
Specialized methods (Myo-Reps, DC Rest-Pause efforts, cluster sets, primer, activator, strength/intensifier preferences) survive restore and render
OS data: defaults, fully populated, and older/partial OS shapes all validate; OS screens render
Unfinished session restores and resumes in the real UI with its entered values
Unknown pa_ key in storage does not make the exported backup unrestorable, and restore leaves it untouched
Export warns clearly when stored data cannot pass this version's restore validation (file is still downloaded)
After restore, the app reloads offline from the service worker with restored data intact
App starts without script errors and makes no external network requests
Every malicious or malformed import is rejected in the UI (no RESTORE button) and storage stays byte-identical
